name: biomodels_search
description: Search EBI BioModels by keyword with recoverable offset pagination. Continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results is the exact upstream match count. BioModels enforces a minimum upstream batch of 10, but this wrapper returns exactly the requested limit.

limit.description: Maximum models to return on this page (1-100).

offset.description: Zero-based model offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

submissionDate.description: When the model was submitted, ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. '2020-05-05T00:00:00Z'.

submitter.description: Name of the person who submitted the model, e.g. 'Ahmad Zyoud'.

url.description: Canonical BioModels page for the model, e.g. 'https://www.biomodels.org/BIOMD0000000944'.

facetStats.description: The same facet breakdown as a JSON STRING, not a parsed object -- it must be json.loads()'d again before use. Redundant with `facets`.

facets.description: EBI search facet blocks for the whole result set, 9 entries, each with its facetValues and counts. This is where the breakdown by curation status, format and organism lives.

queryParameters.description: The query as it was actually executed: {numResults, offset, sortBy, sortDirection}. Check numResults against the models returned to see whether the list was cut.

name: BioModels_get_model
description: Get comprehensive metadata for a specific BioModels entry by its model identifier. Returns detailed information including model name, description, publication references, organism, biological processes, SBML level/version, creation/modification dates, and curator annotations. Use this to understand model details, citations, and biological context before downloading or using a model. Find model IDs using biomodels_search (e.g., 'BIOMD0000000469', 'MODEL1707110000').

model_id.description: BioModels identifier (e.g., 'BIOMD0000000469', 'MODEL1707110000'). Find IDs using biomodels_search. Optionally append '.N' for a specific revision (e.g., 'BIOMD0000000469.1').

format.description: Model format - can be a string or object with name, identifier, and version

contributors.description: Who worked on the model, keyed by role -- {Curator, Modeller} on the measured model.

curationStatus.description: Whether BioModels curated the model, e.g. 'CURATED'. A non-curated model has not been checked to reproduce its paper's figures.

files.description: The model's files as {main, additional}: `main` holds the SBML itself, `additional` the supplementary files. Use BioModels_list_files for the per-file detail.

firstPublished.description: When the model was first published, as a UNIX epoch SECOND count, e.g. 1725285210 -- not an ISO date string.

history.description: Revision history as {revisions}, one entry per submitted version. Which revision a simulation used matters for reproducing it.

modelLevelAnnotations.description: Model-level annotations, each {qualifier, accession, resource, ...} with a BioModels qualifier such as 'bqmodel:is' or 'bqmodel:isDescribedBy', 7 entries on the measured model. The 'isDescribedBy' entries are the publications the model came from.

modellingApproach.description: The modelling formalism, as {accession, name, resource} against an ontology term, e.g. an ODE-based deterministic model. Decides what a simulator can do with the file.

publicationId.description: The curated BioModels accession, e.g. 'BIOMD0000000469'. This is the citable id; submissionId is the pre-curation one, and they differ.

submissionId.description: The id the model was submitted under, e.g. 'MODEL1302140001'. Kept so links from before curation still resolve.

vcsIdentifier.description: BioModels' internal version-control identifier for the record, e.g. 'aaa'. Opaque; not a version number.

name: BioModels_list_files
description: Get detailed file listing for a specific BioModels entry including file names, types, sizes, and metadata. Returns information about all files associated with the model (SBML files, figures, supplementary data, COMBINE archives). Use this before downloading to see what files are available and their formats. Requires model ID from biomodels_search or BioModels_get_model.

model_id.description: BioModels identifier (e.g., 'BIOMD0000000469'). Find IDs using biomodels_search.

return_schema.description: File listing with metadata containing 'main' and 'additional' file arrays

md5sum.description: MD5 of the main model file, e.g. 'd33645d3142b3db02cf909acea37d741'.

sha1sum.description: SHA-1 of the main model file.

sha256sum.description: SHA-256 of the main model file -- the one to verify a download against; MD5 and SHA-1 are kept for older tooling.

name: BioModels_download_model
description: Download a specific file from a BioModels entry or get the download URL for the entire model as a COMBINE archive. Returns download URL and file metadata. Use this to access model files for simulation software (COPASI, CellDesigner, etc.). Specify filename parameter to download a specific file, or omit to get the COMBINE archive containing all files. Find model IDs using biomodels_search.

model_id.description: BioModels identifier (e.g., 'BIOMD0000000469'). Find IDs using biomodels_search.

filename.description: Optional specific filename to download. If not provided, returns COMBINE archive with all files. Use BioModels_list_files to see available filenames.

download_url.description: URL to download the model file

name: BioModels_list_all_model_ids
description: Enumerate ALL BioModels model identifiers - the complete registry of curated (BIOMD...) and non-curated (MODEL...) model IDs. Unlike biomodels_search (keyword search) or BioModels_search_parameters, this returns the full catalog of model IDs so you can iterate over every model in BioModels. Returns a 'hits' count and a 'models' array of identifier strings (e.g. 'BIOMD0000000001'). Use the returned IDs with BioModels_get_model, BioModels_list_files, or BioModels_download_model. The full registry currently contains ~3190 model identifiers.

hits.description: Total number of model identifiers in the registry

models.description: Array of all BioModels identifier strings

name: BioModels_search_parameters
description: Search parameters within BioModels entries using the parameter service's size/start pagination. Continue with metadata.next_offset while metadata.has_more is true; metadata.total_results is the exact filtered count. BioModels enforces a minimum upstream batch of 10, but this wrapper returns exactly the requested limit.

query.description: Search query for parameters (e.g., parameter name like 'k1', 'Km', or biological term). Search across parameter names, values, and annotations.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10, max: 100).

offset.description: Zero-based parameter-record offset. Continue with metadata.next_offset.

return_schema.description: Parameter search results with model IDs and parameter details
